presentation.label: ROOMS
presentation.summary: A multi-mode reverb after the DBA Rooms: Room, Digit, Peak, Gate, Wave and Gong, with Freq and Depth reused per mode.
presentation.overview: A multi-mode reverb after the DBA Rooms: Room, Digit, Peak, Gate, Wave and Gong, with Freq and Depth reused per mode.
highlights: Play a single hit and compare the room settings and tail length.

Play a single hit and compare the room settings and tail length.

controls.name: Mode
controls.doc: params[5]. Reverb character: 0-16 ROOM, 17-33 DIGIT, 34-50 PEAK, 51-66 GATE, 67-83 WAVE, 84-100 GONG. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Time
controls.doc: params[6]. Reverb decay length (all modes). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Freq
controls.doc: params[7]. Per-mode frequency parameter (damping / crush-rate / filter freq / gate-time / LFO rate / gong pitch). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Depth
controls.doc: params[8]. Per-mode depth parameter (size / bit-depth / resonance / threshold / mod depth / regen). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: params[9]. Dry/wet. Default 40 so it's audible on load (custom effects read params as 0 until a knob is touched, so this default is the on-load value). Push it up; high mix + high Time/Depth lets PEAK/GONG self-oscillate. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
